title: 化学实验风险最小化
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/018_化学实验风险最小化.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/018_化学实验风险最小化/src.py

points.K1: 降低风险从好习惯做起
points.K7: 凡事预则立：规划与备齐
points.K9: 装置先检查，用专用器具

shots.scene: 欣欣一手拿小烧杯、一手拿大烧杯，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small beaker in one paw and a large beaker in the other, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲化学实验风险最小化。

shots.scene: 风险指针从高慢慢降到低
shots.prompt_en: A risk dial slowly moves from high to low. No people.
shots.narration: 同一个实验，怎么做风险最小？

shots.scene: 阿杰从药品柜里搬出一大瓶溶剂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a large solvent bottle out of a storage cabinet.
shots.narration: 阿杰要做溶解实验，搬来一大瓶溶剂。

shots.scene: 台面上东西乱放，夹子没夹，器材不全
shots.prompt_en: A cluttered bench with loose clamps and missing equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 台面杂乱，器材也没备齐。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指着讲义
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points at a blank lab handout.
shots.narration: 小研说：先想想怎么把风险降到最小。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 一起来学几个通用的办法。

shots.section_title: 降低风险从好习惯做起
shots.scene: 四步流程图，第三步亮起
shots.prompt_en: A four-step flow chart with the third step highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 识别、评估之后，第三步是降低风险。
overlay: 降低风险从好习惯做起

shots.section_title: 降低风险从好习惯做起
shots.scene: 整洁的台面、盖好的瓶盖、戴好的护目镜
shots.prompt_en: A tidy bench with capped bottles and a pair of safety goggles ready. No people.
shots.narration: 好的操作习惯，就能减少接触和受伤。

shots.section_title: 降低风险从好习惯做起
shots.scene: 小研提醒阿杰盖好瓶盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reminds the young male student to cap a bottle.
shots.narration: 同伴之间，互相提醒。

shots.section_title: 降低风险从好习惯做起
shots.scene: 损失图标：破碎仪器和钱币，被一个盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: Icons of broken equipment and coins blocked by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 也能减少仪器和财产的损失。

shots.scene: 四个问号依次出现
shots.prompt_en: Four question marks appear one by one on a blank board. No people.
shots.narration: 减少暴露，先问自己四个问题。

shots.scene: 高危试剂瓶换成低危试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A high-hazard reagent bottle is swapped for a lower-hazard one. No people.
shots.narration: 一，能不能换成危害小的化学品？

shots.scene: 深色溶液变成浅色溶液
shots.prompt_en: A dark concentrated solution becomes a pale diluted one. No people.
shots.narration: 二，能不能用更稀的浓度？

shots.scene: 大烧杯换成小烧杯
shots.prompt_en: A large beaker is replaced by a small beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 三，能不能少用一点？

shots.scene: 温度计读数从高降低，烫伤图标变淡
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon drops from high to low, and a burn icon fades. No people.
shots.narration: 四，能不能降低温度，减少烫伤？

shots.scene: 四个答案都打勾，暴露指针下降
shots.prompt_en: Four green checks, and an exposure dial drops to low. No people.
shots.narration: 能做到一条，风险就降一级。

shots.scene: 易燃溶剂瓶换成不太易燃的溶剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with a flame pictogram is swapped for a bottle without it. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃溶剂，换成不太易燃的。

shots.scene: 高毒试剂换成低毒试剂
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with a skull pictogram is swapped for a safer bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 高毒试剂，换成低毒的。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔第二层亮起
shots.prompt_en: The second layer of an inverted pyramid glows. No people.
shots.narration: 替代排在消除之后，效果仅次于消除。

shots.scene: 一只手随手换瓶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand casually swapping bottles is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 替代不是随手一换，要按步骤来。

shots.scene: 天平两边：毒性和危险性对比
shots.prompt_en: A balance comparing two bottles by toxicity and flammability icons. No people.
shots.narration: 先比一比，毒性和危险性。

shots.scene: 成本和可行性两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a coin and a gear with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 再看成本和可行性。

shots.scene: 小试管里先做一次小试验，旁边审批章
shots.prompt_en: A small trial in a test tube, next to an approval stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 小试验证，按变更审批再推广。

shots.scene: 旧危害消失，新危害冒出来，打叉
shots.prompt_en: One hazard icon disappears while a new hazard icon pops up, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别用旧危害，换来一个新危害。

shots.scene: 大烧瓶缩小成小烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: A large round-bottom flask shrinks into a small one. No people.
shots.narration: 消除不了，就缩小实验规模。

shots.scene: 常量仪器旁边一套微型仪器
shots.prompt_en: A set of miniature glassware next to a regular-size set. No people.
shots.narration: 能用微量化实验，就不做常量。

shots.scene: 小烧瓶洒了一点，影响范围很小
shots.prompt_en: A small flask spills a little, and only a tiny area is affected. No people.
shots.narration: 万一出错，影响也小。

shots.scene: 钱币图标变多，绿叶图标
shots.prompt_en: A coin icon and a green leaf icon appear next to the small flask. No people.
shots.narration: 用量少，还更省钱。

shots.scene: 【实拍】用移液器只取够用的少量液体（清水代替，手部特写，戴手套）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a gloved hand uses a pipette to take only a small amount of liquid into a small vial.
shots.narration: 做实验，只用够用的最小量。

shots.scene: 领用登记本，阿杰只领一小瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank logbook and receives only a small bottle.
shots.narration: 危险化学品，按需领用，用多少领多少。

shots.scene: 王老师在台账上登记领用
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator records the issued bottle in a blank ledger.
shots.narration: 领用要登记，台账写清楚。

shots.scene: 柜里堆满的试剂瓶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet overstuffed with reagent bottles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不囤积，存得越多风险越大。

shots.scene: 用剩的试剂退回库房
shots.prompt_en: A leftover reagent bottle is returned to a storage room counter. No people.
shots.narration: 用剩的，按规定退回或处置。

shots.section_title: 凡事预则立：规划与备齐
shots.scene: 欣欣举起一张计划表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank planning sheet.
shots.narration: 凡事预则立，每次实验前都要准备。
overlay: 凡事预则立：规划与备齐

shots.section_title: 凡事预则立：规划与备齐
shots.scene: 阿杰翻看讲义、规程和标签
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank handout, a procedure sheet and a bottle label.
shots.narration: 动手前，读讲义、规程和标签。

shots.section_title: 凡事预则立：规划与备齐
shots.scene: 四个图标：危害、防护、急救、处置
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a hazard sign, goggles, a first aid kit and a waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 想清楚危害、防护、急救和处置。

shots.section_title: 凡事预则立：规划与备齐
shots.scene: 试剂、器材和说明书整齐摆在台上
shots.prompt_en: Reagents, equipment and blank safety data sheets laid out neatly on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 材料和安全技术说明书，提前备齐。

shots.section_title: 凡事预则立：规划与备齐
shots.scene: 手忙脚乱找东西的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of someone rushing around looking for things, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 准备，是安全操作化学品的关键。

shots.scene: 一个时钟和实验流程条
shots.prompt_en: A wall clock next to a blank timeline bar of experiment steps. No people.
shots.narration: 时间不够，先排好实验进度。

shots.scene: 流程条上标出几个暂停点
shots.prompt_en: Several safe pause points marked on the timeline bar. No people.
shots.narration: 定好能安全中断的节点。

shots.scene: 赶时间匆忙操作的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hurried person with a clock, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别为赶时间，跳步或匆忙收尾。

shots.scene: 阿杰打哈欠，危险操作图标被暂停
shots.prompt_en: The young male student yawns, and a hazardous step icon is paused.
shots.narration: 太累了，别做危险操作。

shots.scene: 月亮和过夜运行的装置，旁边审批单
shots.prompt_en: A moon icon next to an apparatus running overnight and a blank approval form. No people.
shots.narration: 过夜实验，按学校规定审批。

shots.scene: 门上挂着信息牌：联系人、电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank information tag with a person icon and a phone icon hangs on the apparatus. No people.
shots.narration: 写明联系人，安排好巡查。

shots.section_title: 装置先检查，用专用器具
shots.scene: 【实拍】逐件拿起玻璃仪器对着光检查有无裂纹（手部特写，戴手套）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved hands hold glassware up to the light, checking for cracks.
shots.narration: 搭装置前，逐件检查。
overlay: 装置先检查，用专用器具

shots.section_title: 装置先检查，用专用器具
shots.scene: 干净的仪器打勾，脏的打叉
shots.prompt_en: Clean glassware with a green check, dirty glassware crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 要干净，要能正常工作。

shots.section_title: 装置先检查，用专用器具
shots.scene: 仪器上的检查合格标签和完好的电源线
shots.prompt_en: An instrument with a blank inspection tag and an intact power cord. No people.
shots.narration: 设备开机前，确认状态正常。

shots.section_title: 装置先检查，用专用器具
shots.scene: 用饮料瓶装试剂的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a drink bottle used to hold a chemical, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 要专用器具和容器，就用专用的。

shots.section_title: 装置先检查，用专用器具
shots.scene: 胶带缠着的凑合装置被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A makeshift setup held together with tape, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 临时凑合的替代品，很危险。

shots.scene: 【实拍】用合适的夹具把烧瓶固定在铁架台上，松紧适度（空烧瓶，手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands clamp a flask to a lab stand with a suitable clamp, firm but not overtight.
shots.narration: 搭装置，用合适的夹具，装稳不别劲。

shots.scene: 装置上有一个通向大气的开口，旁边打勾；全封闭装置打叉
shots.prompt_en: Split image: an apparatus with an opening to the air marked with a green check, and a fully sealed apparatus crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 要有通气口，加热不能搭封闭体系。

shots.scene: 刚加热的玻璃仪器旁边一个烫手图标
shots.prompt_en: Freshly heated glassware with a hot-hand warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 热玻璃看着和冷的一样，会烫伤。

shots.scene: 用镊子和簸箕收碎玻璃，徒手捡打叉
shots.prompt_en: Broken glass is picked up with tongs and a dustpan; a bare hand picking it up is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃碎了，别用手捡。

shots.scene: 小烧杯旁一个小废液桶，大烧杯旁一排废液桶
shots.prompt_en: A small beaker next to one small waste container, and a large beaker next to a row of waste containers. No people.
shots.narration: 用量少，危险废物也少。

shots.scene: 废液桶上贴着空白标签，不倒入下水道
shots.prompt_en: A waste container with a blank label; an icon of pouring into a sink is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 产生的废液，分类收集，不倒下水道。

shots.scene: 绿色实验室的绿叶图标
shots.prompt_en: A green leaf icon over a clean lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 减量和替代，也是绿色实验室的要求。

shots.scene: 换、稀、少、冷四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a swap arrow, a diluted beaker, a small beaker and a cool thermometer. No people.
shots.narration: 换、稀、少、冷，规模小，按需领。

shots.scene: 计划表、检查过的仪器、夹好的装置
shots.prompt_en: A blank plan, inspected glassware and a properly clamped apparatus. No people.
shots.narration: 先规划、备齐、检查，装置搭规范。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰互相提醒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student remind each other at the bench.
shots.narration: 养成好习惯，同伴互相提醒。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本分步骤的规程手册挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank step-by-step procedure booklet and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲SOP与方案变更审查。
